The cracks nucleate in the extremely brittle Nb5Si3 phase and interact with the NbSS phase during their extension in the sample, leading to the stretch of NbSS phase. As a result, the sample exhibits a dramatic increment in room temperature tensile strength.
the deformation of the Nb SS phase and the further crack propagation in the Nb5Si3 phase could increase the room temperature mechanical strength.
No Nb3Si peak is detected in the XRD patterns of HT samples, suggesting that the Nb3Si phase has completely converted into Nb SS and Nb5Si3 after HT.
